fact: In Synthesize, the Lead Designer incorporates the resolved issues into one implementation taskbook.
In Confirm, both Member Designers approve the exact implementation taskbook version produced by the Lead Designer or return specific unresolved issues.
After both members confirm a candidate, the Lead signs that exact version, returns proposed changes to both members for response, or asks the user.
Implement starts after the Lead signs the member-confirmed version and the plugin commits the design taskbook.
